errors.what: A single cable leaves the jack and two earbud cables loop around, but there is no Y-splitter where they join. The wiring is ambiguous, and one earbud's wire seems to loop back without a clear connection.

cards.fix: Show one cable from the headphone jack running to a small Y-splitter, then two separate wires, one to each earbud.

errors.where: horizontal strut on the left support post, under the upper slide curve
errors.what: The short brace sticks out sideways from the post and ends in the air short of the slide trough, so it supports nothing.

cards.fix: Make the brace on the left post attach firmly to the underside of the slide trough with a bracket, or remove it.
